A Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BSN), plus either a completed Master’s degree in Nursing or a related field, or active enrollment in a Master’s program with completion required within three (3) years of hire. Experience in a Primary Care Clinic
Minimum of five (5) years experience direct patient care nursing experience in acute care of ambulatory.

The Nurse Manager is responsible for the daily planning, organizing, directing, and controlling of the daily operations and clinical practice of assigned patient care areas, in order to provide quality, individualized patient care and support of Medical Center philosophies. The Nurse Manager will lead staff to model a professional practice environment by: providing a clinically competent staff; encouraging strong interdisciplinary team collaboration and communication; supporting autonomy and accountability; providing staff opportunities for in- service and formal education; stressing the importance of continuous learning; and supporting a culture where concern for the patient is paramount.
25% - Leadership, Management, and Organizational Functions

The Nurse Manager supports research, participates in both long- and short-term strategic planning, and assures patient advocacy. The Nurse Manager is accountable to the Practice Manager and Director of Ambulatory Nursing Practice. This position supports additional UC Davis Health ambulatory locations. This position supports the Roseville Clinic and has clinical oversight of two community clinics in Auburn and Rocklin. Travel to sites is required.
20% - Staff Supervision, Team Development & HR Management
15% - Patient Care Oversight & Customer Experience
15% - Compliance, Regulatory & Fiscal Management
15% - Quality Improvement, Safety & Operations
10% - Professional Development, Education & Research
Meets specialty specific clinical competencies for assigned area
Full command (verbal and written) of the English language.

Job requires occasional provision of direct patient care, including moving and positioning patients (with assistance as needed to ensure employee and patient safety) and assisting with multiple exams and procedures that cumulatively may last several hours at a time. Job also typically requires frequent movement throughout the clinic
Strong interpersonal and communication skills
Working knowledge of applicable Standards of Practice
Knowledgeable and proficient in the use of health care technology within specialty area
Demonstrates a commitment to customer service and an ability to meet the needs and expectations of patients and health care colleagues.
Knowledge of Joint Commission, Title XXII, federal and state regulations
